text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Owww! OUCH!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It hurts like crazy!
This is all your fault,
Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...No! No way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be a great witch like
Grandma! I won't
let something like this
slow me down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let me train, Familiar! That's an order!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let me train, Familiar! That's an order!
choice_data_list: Let's just do what we can.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?!
choice_data_list: Let's just do what we can.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your master is giving you an order! Do
something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to avoid a tantrum while I explain
the risk of her injury getting worse.
Somehow, I manage to
convince her to
rest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whatever! I'm not gonna move, then! I'm
staying
right here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, go get me some dinner, Familiar!
And don't
forget dessert!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And a TV and some comics too! This is
my new
home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is in a full-on pout, and it
takes a
while for her injury to fully
recover.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, now you're getting it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot to do if I'm gonna be a
great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's hurry up and get back to
training!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Owww!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It hurts, Familiar! Do something!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh... But then I can't be like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I manage to settle Sweep
Tosho down,
she remains in a bad mood
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe, look! I can run! This is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of a genius magical
girl! I'm
gonna be just like Grandma in
no time! Just
watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, it turns out that Sweep Tosho's
injury isn't
too serious.
